summary: San Francisco Bay Area, software engineer, computer science background, strong interest in programming languages (especially Python, Java, C++), advocates for NoSQL databases (MongoDB), critical of relational databases, enjoys discussing software architecture and design patterns, supports open-source software, skeptical of corporate practices, interested in technology history and nostalgia, values user experience in software design, critical of over-engineering in programming, engaged in discussions about tech industry ethics and practices, prefers practical solutions over theoretical ones, has a critical view of government regulations affecting technology, likely to participate in tech-related communities and discussions.
